kind: real purchase and management UI plus explicitly prepared upgrade/visit save fixtures
checks: From a new game, a paid ferry and real remote-dice trip reach stop 12; choosing the garden charges the displayed engine price (including any existing luck discount) and updates the actual scene to park L0.
Normal pre-roll management converts garden to mall for ¥300, disables same-type repeat actions and survives reload.
A disclosed L3 save fixture upgrades through the real landing button for ¥1380, previews ¥2565 → ¥4050 and displays the L4 clock-tower mall.
L4 → park warns about permanently losing three levels with no refund; applying it displays L1 pavilion and persists the capped level.
At 390px the operating ledger, both choices and conversion buttons remain readable without horizontal overflow.
An opponent-owned L1 garden visit fixture charges zero rent, reports +30 points and does not pay the benefit again after reload.
